title: Jovial Venezuelan Cheese Pie
description: A creamy, savory cheese pie with a classic mother sauce base, baked in flaky shortcrust pastry, perfect for sharing at any gathering.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F) and lightly oil the baking dish.
In a saucepan, melt butter over medium heat, then stir in flour until a smooth roux forms and lightly browns, about 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in milk and cream, cooking until the sauce thickens and coats the back of a spoon, about 5 minutes.
Season the sauce with salt and pepper, then swirl in minced garlic and remove from heat.
Place the pastry sheet in the prepared dish, pressing it gently into the edges and trimming the excess.
Spread the warm mother sauce evenly over the pastry base.
Sprinkle the grated queso blanco over the sauce, then top with chopped parsley.
Drizzle olive oil over the top and bake for 25 minutes until the pastry is golden and the cheese is bubbly.
Let the pie cool for 5 minutes before slicing.
